title: Solvent polarity effects on the FTIR spectrum, and thermodynamic and electronic properties of metronidazole and its binding with antibacterial drugs: a DFT and molecular docking study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28538-28554
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02359A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Desta Regassa Golj, Megersa Olumana Dinka, Umer Sherefedin, Abebe Belay, Dereje Gelanu, Gadisa Deme Megersa
This study investigates solvent polarity effects on the FTIR spectrum, and thermodynamic and electronic properties of metronidazole via semiempirical, Hartree-Fock, and DFT methods. Its binding with antibacterial drugs was also investigated.
